A4_source_classes.rationale: Capture requires an authorized, versioned, rights-eligible source and qualified adapter (REC-006); authored action, typed owner-result readback, postcondition and finality (REC-013); and business-result comparison rather than visual polish or a click/screenshot (REC-045). The five-class composition case rejects generated/synthetic assets represented as real observations (DECL-053).

Specification-backed visuals have bounded declarative inputs, stable editable semantic nodes/data bindings, explicit story-time keyframes, and bounded procedural operators. The general taxonomy says rendering does not prove product effects or scientific correctness.

The source distinguishes model family and typed/model semantics from visual appearance, requires model identity/equations/validity, unit-bearing quantities and explicit solver selection, and separates visual fidelity, model fidelity, and validation tier. Missing qualification facts remain UNQUALIFIED; domain-science authority stays with the named qualified domain owner.

Origin disclosure distinguishes source-free authored/generated output from consumed source lineage and requires model/engine/profile provenance when applicable, plus produced-versus-estimated labeling. Generated and illustrative values cannot become measurements; generated assets cannot be classified as real observations; rights/consent govern each mixed-source effect and egress.

The fixture case requires synthetic-only classification and rejects solver calibration, product-effect, and scientific-truth claims from Explorer fixture replay. Recorder execution fixture seeding is fenced and scoped; it does not convert a fixture into an observed product result.

Business-state proof requires owner result/postcondition; scientific validity requires documented model/validation facts; render polish cannot stand in for either; generated values and fixture replay retain distinct evidence labels.

clockDistinctions.sourceVideoPTS_DTS: source_decode_and_presentation_timestamps has original time base, PTS/DTS, stream identity, and mapping; VFR preserves a presentation map or produces a separately identified normalized artifact with explicit report.
clockDistinctions.audioSampleTime: audio_sample_time uses integer sample index plus rational rate; sample format/layout/count and encoder priming/padding are explicit metadata.
clockDistinctions.t_story: story/explanation/editorial presentation time uses rational seconds or exact frame/sample position; pause/seek does not alter model state absent a declared timeline action.
clockDistinctions.t_sim: domain/model simulation time has explicit domain unit; story pause/scrub does not advance it absent bounded model command.
clockDistinctions.wall_clock: operational deadlines, timeout/lease durations, and monotonic process elapsed time are separate from media and simulation time.
clockDistinctions.conversion_and_uncertainty: Each mapping names source/destination clock/rate, origin, rounding/interval policy and measured loss or unknown; rational PTS/rate rather than rounded fps drives mapping; VFR, drift, rounding, encoder priming/padding, and unavailable policies are explicit.

fidelityDistinctions.LOD_vs_model_fidelity: simulationAndFidelity.domainFidelity explicitly separates scientific/model fidelity from visual quality and visual level of detail; it prohibits a Media alias for TutorPutor-owned F0-F4.
fidelityDistinctions.qualification_expectations: Replay classes distinguish exact-environment, tolerance-bound, statistical, and replay-unavailable claims. Unqualified solver/output replay remains unavailable/unresolved. P0 simulation rules prohibit cross-family solver substitution and require exact family, inputs/outputs, units/bounds, domain owner, and validation meaning; visual plausibility is not scientific correctness.

A5_clocks_and_fidelity.acceptanceCriterion: Keep all named clocks independent absent explicit conversion/action; unknown/inexact mappings disclose uncertainty/loss or fail closed; never infer scientific F0-F4 from visual polish/LOD; unsupported or unqualified model behavior remains unavailable/unqualified rather than silently substituted.
A5_clocks_and_fidelity.disposition: No P0 semantic defect identified. Detailed typed value definitions and conversion ownership are explicitly pending in P0 source authorityBoundary/owner handoff and belong to a later phase; do not count that as omitted P0 product meaning.
